best_idea: A swing time that a speed skill mod shortens toward a floor (exactly the base at zero, never below the floor), clamped at both ends, so one stat can speed attacks without reaching zero or blowing up on negative values.
decision_why: Frankendom has no attack-speed stat yet; take the bounded shape, clamp both ends, keep the two curve values as engine constants, and store the mod once on the character record.
acceptance: A server test asserts mod 0 gives the base swing time exactly, a large positive mod never gives a swing below the floor, a large negative mod is clamped, and the same mod gives the same swing time in a Pit fight and a zone fight (both call src/fight/swing.ts).
